description: Make unfinished [cvrt] Media records due again (needs [cvrt] Media 0.1.1+): resets the back-off counters only, never touches a file; the runner's next pass works them. Needs exactly one scope: ids (attachment ids, at most 500) or all: true (every stuck record). Returns { retried, counts }.

all.description: Scope: true retries every stuck record

ids.description: Scope: attachment ids to retry, at most 500

name: media_retry_recovery
